known_facts_book1: A lean man with a hard sullen face and eyes glowing like coals through the slits of his half-closed eyelids, who rules Jinxland from a castle near a grove of stately trees.
Is a usurper with no right to the title: he was Prime Minister to King Phearse and murdered him by tripping him backward into a deep pond and weighting him down with stones.
Is guardian to his niece, Princess Gloria, and commands her to marry the aged courtier Googly-Goo for the bushel and a half of jewels Googly-Goo has promised.
Beats Pon with his fists and his golden staff, and has his guards flog the gardener's boy in front of Gloria.
Favors the Wicked Witches of Jinxland and pays Blinkie large sums to work his cruelties, which makes him hate her almost as much as his subjects do.
Fears Cap'n Bill is a wizard because he crossed the desert, and has Blinkie transform him rather than risk him.
Threatens to burn Blinkie at the stake if she fails to freeze Gloria's heart.
Has the Scarecrow bound with Googly-Goo's rope, thrust into the castle prison, and then tied to a stake on a great bonfire before his assembled people.
Is blown off his throne by the descending Orks, pinned to the ground by one of them, and bound with ropes by his own soldiers.

Is spared by Gloria and Pon, who make him the castle's gardener's boy on condition that he reform and change his name from Krewl to Grewl — and he goes out to water the roses in Pon's old brown smock.

known_relations_book1.Gloria: His niece and ward, whom he imprisons, drags by the arm and sells to Googly-Goo.
known_relations_book1.Googly-Goo: The rich courtier who pays for the witchcraft and expects Gloria in return.
known_relations_book1.Pon: The gardener's boy he beats, and the son of the King he murdered.
known_relations_book1.Blinkie: The Wicked Witch he pays and threatens.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: The stranger who defies him in Ozma's name and takes his crown.
known_relations_book1.Cap'n Bill: The stranger he has turned into a grasshopper.

not_in_this_book: King Krewl is the rightful King of Jinxland
relationships: King Krewl is a friend of Gloria
King Krewl is an ally of the Scarecrow

known_facts_book1: A skinny old courtier dressed in rich velvets with furbelows and laces, covered with golden chains, rings and jeweled ornaments, who walks with mincing steps.
Is old enough to be Gloria's father and has asked her to marry him thirty-nine times, being refused every time.
Has laid aside more than a bushel — later a bushel and a half — of precious gems to present to the King on the day he weds Gloria.
Smiles as a serpent smiles, for he has no teeth except a couple of fangs.
Proposes throwing Pon into the Great Gulf, and when the King says that would not help, agrees the thing to kill is Gloria's love.
Pays the Wicked Witch's whole price for freezing Gloria's heart, and afterward claims he has been robbed when Gloria still refuses him.
Is knocked into a muddy ditch by Gloria herself when he catches at her arm.
Suggests to the King that the Scarecrow be burned on a bonfire, and lights the pile with his own match.
Is shot into a tree by the Orks' wind and left hanging by the middle from a high limb, howling for mercy, and is bound beside Krewl when he slides down.

known_relations_book1.King Krewl: His fellow plotter, whom he pays and advises.
known_relations_book1.Gloria: The Princess he tries to buy and who knocks him into a ditch.
known_relations_book1.Blinkie: The witch whose fee he pays in full.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Whom he binds with rope and sets on fire.

relationships: Googly-Goo is a friend of Gloria
Googly-Goo is Gloria's suitor whom she accepts

known_facts_book1: The gardener's boy at King Krewl's castle, in a long brown smock and sandals, with a shock of brown curly hair.
Is the son of King Phearse, who ruled Jinxland before Krewl and was murdered by him; Pon has served Krewl for years without the King knowing who he is.
Did not love Gloria first: she looked at him tenderly, spoke to him, and told him he had touched her heart, and he returned her love because it would have been impolite not to.
Is beaten by the King's fist and boot, and later flogged by two guards in front of the Princess.
Shelters Trot and Button-Bright in his hut after they are turned out of the castle.
Watches through Blinkie's window with Trot while Gloria's heart is frozen, and is repelled by the Princess afterwards.
Is sent by the Scarecrow to summon King Krewl to surrender, and gets a drubbing with the golden staff for it.
Is told plainly by the Scarecrow that his father had no right to rule either, and that only Gloria is entitled to the throne.
Is raised to the seat beside Gloria at her coronation and made her Royal Consort, becoming King of Jinxland by her choice.
Gives his old brown smock to the deposed Krewl, who takes over his gardening duties.

known_relations_book1.Gloria: His sweetheart, who is frozen against him and then restored, and who makes him her Royal Consort.
known_relations_book1.King Krewl: The usurper who murdered his father and who beats him twice.
known_relations_book1.Trot: The little girl he searches Jinxland with and shelters in his hut.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Who denies his claim to the throne but makes him the messenger.

not_in_this_book: Pon becomes King of Jinxland in his own right
Pon's father was the rightful King
Pon melts Gloria's frozen heart with his love

known_facts_book1: The loveliest and sweetest maiden in Jinxland, niece and ward of King Krewl, who lives in his castle and is fond of flowers.
Is the daughter of King Kynd, the good ruler of Jinxland, who fell into the bottomless Great Gulf; she is the only person with a right to the throne.
Refuses Googly-Goo thirty-nine times and assures Pon she will wed only him.
Is bound hand to hand, dragged to Blinkie's eight-sided house by two soldiers and tied to a post in the center of the room.
Has her heart frozen, not her love destroyed: her body turns transparent and her heart goes from red to gray to white, frosted over with icicles.
Says her heart is frozen to all mortal loves and that she does not love even herself; Trot says her voice sounds like a refrigerator.
Knocks Googly-Goo into a ditch when he catches her arm, and tells him she will wed no one at all.

Is thawed by Blinkie under the Scarecrow's compulsion, using the last of a purple powder of which there is no more in all the world, burned with a lock of the witch's own hair and a strip of her gown.
Throws herself into Pon's arms the instant her heart beats warm again.
Is chosen Queen of Jinxland by the people, crowned by the Scarecrow, and raises Pon to the throne beside her as Royal Consort.

known_relations_book1.Pon: Her sweetheart, whom she loves, rejects while frozen, and finally makes her Royal Consort.
known_relations_book1.King Krewl: Her uncle and guardian, who imprisons her and sells her hand.
known_relations_book1.Googly-Goo: The old courtier she refuses thirty-nine times and knocks into a ditch.
known_relations_book1.Blinkie: The witch who freezes her heart and is forced to thaw it.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Who refuses to crown her until her heart is warm, then crowns her Queen.
